purpose: Aggressive non-decisional robustness attack. Quantify how much execution cost, carry, gap loss, correlated loss and adverse sequencing DH-03 can absorb without changing setup logic or selecting favorable cells after outcomes.

source.unresolved_rows: exclude exactly the two official execution-path-unresolved rows; no imputation

stage_A_full_factor_ledger_stress.limitation: Trade-ledger sequencing diagnostic only; does not claim exact intraday Kraken MDL/floating-equity path.

stage_C_monte_carlo_sequence_risk.sample_unit: all resolved trades sharing the same UTC entry date are aggregated as one block to retain same-day cross-symbol clustering
stage_C_monte_carlo_sequence_risk.horizon_blocks: same number of distinct historical UTC entry days as source sample
stage_C_monte_carlo_sequence_risk.limitation: Sequence-risk/MDD diagnostic only. It does not estimate exact Kraken intraday MDL because historical proprietary mark/bid/ask depth is unavailable.

stage_D_policy.automatic_next_step: Every cell/profile that survives Stages A-C remains eligible for a later predeclared 1m combined-severe shadow/MTM envelope; no manual winner selection.

research_tier_evidence.RESEARCH_DIAMOND_candidate_condition: positive frozen holdout already exists AND robustness evidence remains materially positive under severe predeclared stresses; no prop-production claim follows automatically
research_tier_evidence.EXECUTION_DIAMOND_candidate_condition: requires subsequent 1m/shadow execution robustness plus operational detector validation
research_tier_evidence.PRODUCTION_DIAMOND_condition: still requires authoritative platform execution compatibility and separate real-capital authorization
